name: snowy-balls-tooling
description: Dev-only tooling for Snowy Balls - the game itself ships as a static site (index.html + src/*.js), nothing here is deployed to players. Used to run the Firebase Local Emulator Suite (Firestore + Functions + Auth) for testing Cloud Functions against a fully local, throwaway sandbox that never touches the real project - see docs/NOTES.md and the snowy-balls-blaze-migration memory.
